originalTitle: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
summary: The father had threatened to behead a female primary school teacher near Toulouse.
content:
The father was given a fast-tracked hearing in Toulouse

A man has been given a six-month jail term in France after he threatened to kill a female primary school teacher who had disciplined his son at a village primary school.

He was sentenced after a fast-track hearing on Thursday, six days after the events unfolded in Le Fauga, a village with a population of about 2,600 just outside the southwestern city of Toulouse.

The teacher has been granted official protection and has gone on sick leave.

French Education Minister Edouard Geffray said: "No teacher should be afraid to do their job. Attacking one of them is attacking the entire institution."

Over the summer, Geffray steered through a law aimed at protecting staff from a "significant risk" to their safety or health from a member of a student's family.

The minister said this case would trigger one of the first uses of the decree.

The case revives terrible memories in France of the beheading of a teacher in the Paris suburb of Conflans-Sainte-Honorine six years ago. Samuel Paty was murdered outside his school by an 18-year-old Chechen refugee.

In Le Fauga, the teacher's colleagues did not go into work on Monday because of what had happened the previous Friday.

The threat was made after the man had been called in for a chat with the school, according to Toulouse education chief Karim Benmiloud.

Le Fauga Mayor Jean-Marie Puig told BFMTV that the man's son had been disruptive in class and the teacher had sent him to another class to calm down, although he continued to misbehave.

The teacher in this class was alleged to have told the child to "stop acting like a little bully", BFMTV reports.

She was then threatened by the father, who according to the mayor had waited for her "outside the school and apparently threatened to cut off her head if she'd been a man".

The parent subsequently apologised, however a judicial complaint was made and he went before the prosecutor in Toulouse on Thursday afternoon.

The decree passed in July allows for a student to be transferred to another school in a case involving significant risk to staff, and where education authorities have intervened.

It is thought the boy and a younger sister may now be moved to another school outside Le Fauga.

chineseTitle: 法国一男子威胁要杀死儿子的老师，被判入狱
chineseSummary: 父亲威胁要斩首图卢兹附近的一名女小学教师。
chineseContent:
父亲在图卢兹接受了快速听证会

法国一名男子因威胁要杀死一名在乡村小学管教他儿子的女小学教师而被判处六个月监禁。

周四，Le Fauga 事件发生六天后，他在快速听证会后被判刑。Le Fauga 是西南部城市图卢兹郊外的一个人口约 2,600 人的村庄。

该老师已获得官方保护并已休病假。

法国教育部长爱德华·格弗雷(Edouard Geffray)表示：“任何教师都不应该害怕做好自己的工作。攻击其中一个人就是攻击整个机构。”

今年夏天，杰弗雷主导通过了一项法律，旨在保护教职员工免受学生家庭成员的安全或健康“重大风险”。

部长表示，此案将引发该法令的首次使用之一。

此案勾起了法国人对六年前在巴黎郊区孔夫兰圣奥诺里讷一名教师被斩首的可怕记忆。塞缪尔·帕蒂 (Samuel Paty) 在学校外被一名 18 岁的车臣难民谋杀。

在Le Fauga，由于上周五发生的事情，老师的同事周一没有上班。

图卢兹教育主管卡里姆·本米卢德表示，这名男子是在被学校叫去谈话后发出威胁的。

Le Fauga 市长 Jean-Marie Puig 告诉 BFMTV，该男子的儿子在课堂上捣乱，老师已把他送到另一个班级冷静下来，但他的行为仍然不端。

据 BFMTV 报道，该班老师据称曾告诉孩子“不要表现得像个小恶霸”。

然后她受到父亲的威胁，据市长称，父亲“在学校外面等她，并威胁说，如果她是男人，就要砍掉她的头”。

这名家长随后道歉，但随后提出了司法申诉，并于周四下午在图卢兹接受了检察官的审判。

7 月通过的法令允许在对教职员工构成重大风险且教育当局进行干预的情况下将学生转移到另一所学校。

据认为，这名男孩和一个妹妹现在可能会被转移到 Le Fauga 以外的另一所学校。
